name: lwc-datatable-plus
description: Feature-rich Lightning Web Component datatable for the Salesforce platform

scripts.test:apex: sf apex run test --target-org dtp-dev --result-format human --code-coverage --wait 10
scripts.deploy: sf project deploy start --target-org dtp-dev --source-dir force-app --test-level NoTestRun --wait 10
scripts.deploy:validate: sf project deploy start --target-org dtp-dev --source-dir force-app --test-level RunLocalTests --dry-run --wait 10
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:lwc:coverage && npm run deploy:validate && npm run deploy && npm run test:apex
